title: activate() ignores `path` when the locale was activated before from another path
property: activate(locale, path) loads the catalogue from `path`; if none exists there it raises FileNotFoundError, regardless of earlier activations
input: activate('fr_FR', dirA) (has catalogue) then activate('fr_FR', emptyDir)
expected: FileNotFoundError because emptyDir has no fr_FR catalogue (and a different dir's catalogue is used if it differs)
actual: Returns the cached translations from dirA silently; `path` is ignored because _TRANSLATIONS is keyed by locale only
evidence: Docstring: 'Search for locale in directory `path`' and 'Raises: FileNotFoundError: If humanize cannot find the locale folder'. Cache key at i18n.py:88 omits path.
